children: shares surged 10% Wednesday morning after the company delivered better-than-expected third-quarter revenue and earnings, with its artificial intelligence business accounting for more than half of total sales.

The company reported revenue of $14.58 billion for the quarter, up 161% from a year earlier and above Wall Street estimates of $12.74 billion. Earnings reached 35 cents per share, topping analysts' expectations of 12 cents, according to a Tuesday press release.

SpaceX's Super Intelligence segment, which houses its AI operations, generated $7.6 billion in revenue, an 830% annual increase. Connectivity revenue rose 69% to $5.2 billion, while its Space segment recorded $1.8 billion, up 6%.

The Space business completed 12 customer launches during the quarter, including its first revenue-generating Starship mission. SpaceX also reported 113 launches year to date and 13.6 million Starlink subscribers at quarter-end.

The company ended the quarter with $53.39 billion in cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash. Its Super Intelligence segment recorded $4.6 billion in expenses, compared with $974 million for Connectivity and $367 million for Space.

title: SpaceX Shares Jump After AI Revenue Soars 830%
